BUILDPLAN: M-11 — Wave 1 (§4) ⚠️ LANDS BEFORE ANY SEND PATH

Scope (verbatim): Template store, `{{merge}}` renderer, `outbox` table writes with `idempotency_key`, queue consumer as **the single choke point** that calls Resend, demo-safe allowlist enforced *in the consumer* as one rule — **suppress unless `send_policy='always_live'` or `to_email` ∈ allowlist** — with `always_live` written by exactly two call sites (the public-form confirmation for an address typed in that request, and the `smoke:mail`/`smoke:ics` harness); the auth trigger keys `magic_link_login`, `draft_resume`, `task_link` exist from the first commit so **no route ever has a reason to call Resend directly**; `Idempotency-Key` header, two send paths from the start (**batch for plain bulk, single-send ≤10/s for anything carrying an ICS** — trap 14), comms log screen with rendered previews.

Guardrail G3 (audited by A-3): no module imports Resend but the consumer; exactly two `always_live` write sites; all seven triggers plus bulk suppressed under demo mode.
Trap 3: Resend Free is 100 sends/day — the outbox and demo-safe allowlist are built either way.

File surface: `src/jobs/mail/*`, `src/routes/comms.routes.ts`, `src/ui/comms/*`

ACs: AC-33, AC-117, AC-125 – AC-131 foundation
Hours: 6
Workflow: inline-full
Shared files: none — module-local. The **queue consumer is the single Resend call site** for the whole codebase; every other ticket enqueues.
Deps: M-02, M-07
Audit that keys off this ticket: A-3 (mail containment), from CP-2
Plan: filled in by delegator's plan phase

data.body:
MRQ-12 completion

HEAD: 643e641e6d44989f20176598c49d16610da5a99e
PR: https://forgejo.stage11.ai/atin/marquee/pulls/14 (open against master)

Mandatory gate result:
{
  "command": "pr-gate",
  "ticket": "MRQ-12",
  "status": "pass",
  "elapsedMs": 13398
}
The gate also reported 17 test files / 95 tests passed, check:design PASS, and merged trace:ac PASS with live=197, testFiles=21, claims=8, uncovered=0, errors=0.

Local runtime validation: wrangler dev --local plus local D1 and Queue exercised POST /api/v1/auth/magic-link; the consumer produced a magic_link_login row with status=suppressed, send_policy=demo_safe, and suppressed_reason=demo_mode_not_allowlisted. No real provider call was made.

Guardrail G3: the only always_live write sites are enqueuePublicFormConfirmation (typed-address public-form confirmation) and enqueueSmokeHarnessMail (smoke:mail/smoke:ics harness). Generic auth, trigger, bulk, and comms paths use the demo_safe default. The consumer is the only Resend call site.

Idempotency: AC-117 test repeats the same bulk action and asserts one outbox row and one delivery via the UNIQUE SHA-256 key.

Artifacts: self-review art_01KZQ8PMGCSPTNGG2RKHE2RM5F; validation art_01KZQ8Q5GJGBBT1G3NMJT1BKD2; PR reference art_01KZQ8TZNDSF4TCWJDPEZ18KMQ.

MRQ-57 checklist: real Resend credential/account delivery and production Cloudflare resources remain unverified and deferred; not faked locally.

Merged as PR #14 (squash f15a5f5c). GUARDRAIL VERIFIED BY COUNTING, not by report: exactly TWO always_live write sites exist in the whole tree — enqueuePublicFormConfirmation and enqueueSmokeHarnessMail. The first carries a defence I did not ask for and want kept: it rejects unless toEmail equals the address typed in that request, so a live public-form send cannot be redirected to an arbitrary recipient. Everything else, auth mail included, defaults to demo_safe (documented at src/lib/auth/auth-mail.ts:12). AC-117 idempotency is enforced by catching the UNIQUE constraint violation (isUniqueConstraint), not a racing pre-check — exactly as required. pr-gate PASS, 17 files / 95 tests, trace:ac uncovered=0. The only credential-shaped string in the diff is RESEND_API_KEY: 'test-key' inside a test. Real Resend validation deferred to MRQ-57.
